content.title: 2022 ACC/AHA Aortic Disease Guideline
main topics: Mutations impact on pregnancy and aortic diseases.
Delivery and pregnancy in patients with Marfan syndrome.

sections.title: Mutations
sections.content: Discussion of mutations from the Montalcino Aortic Consortium with focus on genetic risks and management in vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome and Loeys-Dietz syndrome.
references: Aortic dissection in pregnant patients with Marfan syndrome.

sections.title: Pregnancy in Patients with Aortic Disease
sections.content: Considerations and guidelines for pregnant patients with Marfan syndrome, including maternal and fetal complications and acute complications associated with pregnancy and delivery.
references: Registry data and prospective studies on pregnancy outcomes in women with Marfan syndrome.
